captureViewport: Dialog scenes use QDialog::grab at QT_SCALE_FACTOR=1 and QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen. The small-success-handoff scene captures the refreshed Schedule PageHost at 1024x768.
largeDataInterpretation: The parser stress workbook contains 96 candidates across five schedule blocks; its selected conflict block contains 20 model rows. A separate non-overlapping 20-candidate block is applied to a real .tps store and persisted counts are recorded. No 96-row apply is claimed.
legacyReferenceScope: Legacy source, selected sheet/block, and small review use the same small workbook as Next; overlap conflict uses the same fixture in English/Korean and light/dark. The 96-candidate stress capture is Next-specific.
memoryScope: Samples cover the whole test process on this host, including Qt, the page host, current workflow, and runtime caches. They do not attribute bytes to the parser or prove a process memory budget.
visualDifferences: Shared workflow states are captured with Fusion and explicit light/dark palettes. Legacy and Next source/selection dialogs are 436x520; review/conflict dialogs are 800x800. Next's narrow candidate preview clips part of a meeting time until horizontal scrolling; its overlap status is generic and does not identify the conflicting pair, while Legacy shows the conflicting class details. Legacy Korean retains some English fallback strings. The images compare state and content, not pixel parity.
